reports.title: Parsons* third quarter earnings press release

guidance.heading: Fiscal Year 2026 Guidance
section: The company is narrowing and reiterating the mid-point of its fiscal year 2026 revenue and adjusted EBITDA guidance ranges and reiterating its operating cash flow guidance range.

Current Fiscal Year2026 Guidance | Prior Fiscal Year2026 Guidance
Revenue | $6.25 billion - $6.45 billion | $6.20 billion - $6.50 billion
Adjusted EBITDA including non-controlling interest | $510 million - $550 million | $500 million - $560 million
Cash Flow from Operating Activities | $430 million - $490 million | $430 million - $490 million
